Definition: from G575 and G2572; to take off the cover, i.e. disclose:--reveal.
BiblicalUsage: To take off the cover, to disclose. Jesus thanks the Father because He has hid these things from the wise and prudent and revealed them unto babes, in Matthew 11:25 and again in Luke 10:21 — the same words in both Gospels. God has revealed them unto us by His Spirit in 1 Corinthians 2:10, for the Spirit searcheth the deep things of God, and in Romans 1:17 the righteousness of God is revealed from faith to faith.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the uncovering is God's work from first to last. The wise miss it because they look for it with the wrong eyes; babes receive it because they only have to be told. The Spirit does the revealing, faith does the receiving, and my part is to stay small enough to be taught.
